caption:
Doubling time goes in the exponent.

P = P₀ · 2^(t/d). 500 bacteria doubling every 4 hours, after 12 hours: 500 · 2³ = 4,000. Half-life swaps the 2 for ½.

Follow @samsonsatprep for daily SAT tips.
tiktok_caption: Doubles every 4 hours? After 12 hours that's 2³, not 2¹².

youtube.title: Doubling Time and Half-Life Formula for the SAT
youtube.description: The doubling/half-life formula isn't on the SAT reference sheet. Worked example: 500 bacteria doubling every 4 hours become 500 · 2³ = 4,000 after 12 hours.
